title: 第五章 李云岫 抓住你了第六章 王昱说剑
content_zh:
严老死了。
这位年轻时曾经只身杀入太恒山，威震大河南北岸，刚刚还轻松击败南海双剑，被皇帝派来保护自己的秘密高手，就这么轻易的死了。
王昱嘴角抽搐，如此高手，却死的这么草率，这个世界也太危险了吧？
呼啦一声，大厅中的所有客人一阵骚动。
要是普通的江湖厮杀，他们说不得也就看热闹了，但有人中毒，他们也不由得担心自己会不会被波及。
厅中的客人应激起身，十个禁卫在宋勇的带领下也齐齐拔刀，虎视眈眈。
只有李云岫依然沉静，看看严老的尸体，又看向瑟瑟发抖，几乎快要稳不住身形的店伙，“带我去后厨放茶水的地方。”
李云岫的话语给了店伙力量，只见他连连点头，回头就走。
“王妃？”宋勇看向李云岫。
李云岫摆摆手，“从我们没有喝那三碗茶的时候，凶手就不会继续留在店里了。”
宋勇挥手，众禁卫收刀。
李云岫跟着店伙走进后厨，王昱和紫菱也跟着进去。
后厨只是普通的后厨，大师傅还在灶台间做饭，另有一位帮厨刚刚将切好的肉送到灶台旁，给自己倒了碗凉茶，正在悠闲的喝着。
他的脸也变成了青黑色。
“你……你……”店伙指着帮厨，几乎说不出话来。
“我怎么了？”帮厨出声问道，“你怎么带着客人进……”
同样是话音未落，帮厨便两眼一黑，翻身便倒。
李云岫冷着脸来到盛放凉茶的铁锅前，轻轻嗅了嗅，叹了口气，也松了口气。
“上车，启程！”
……

禁卫中分出一个人驾驶马车，所有人空着肚子继续上路。
倒是有个禁卫想要从食肆隔壁的包子铺中买几个包子充饥，但李云岫将他买来的包子扔给了路边的一条野狗。
当见到那条野狗“嗷呜”一声之后便浑身抽搐着倒地而死，所有人都不说话了。
“对方是个很会算计人心的人。”李云岫沉声道，“他算到我们不敢继续在食肆中用餐，也算到我们出来后可能会在旁边的包子铺买包子充饥。”
“如果我们再找一家食肆呢？”紫菱问道。
“也许那家食肆的饮食里就有毒了。”李云岫淡淡的道。
“那我们岂不是能找到他？”紫菱问道。
“他总是快我们一步，我们怎么找他？”李云岫问道。
“他究竟是什么人，怎么这么厉害？”
“他是什么人我不知道，但我知道他其实也没那么厉害。”
“啊？”
content_en:
Old Yan is dead.
This secret master who once entered Taiheng Mountain alone when he was young and shocked the north and south banks of the river. He had just easily defeated the two swords of the South China Sea and was sent by the emperor to protect him. He died so easily.
The corner of Wang Yu's mouth twitched. Such a master died so hastily. Isn't this world too dangerous?
With a roar, all the guests in the hall were in commotion.
If it were an ordinary fight in the rivers and lakes, they would just watch the excitement, but if someone was poisoned, they couldn't help but worry about whether they would be affected.
The guests in the hall stood up in response, and the ten guards, led by Song Yong, also drew their swords and stared at him eagerly.
Only Li Yunxiu remained calm. He looked at Old Yan's body and then at the shivering waiter, who was almost losing his balance. "Take me to the back kitchen where the tea is kept."
Li Yunxiu's words gave the shopkeeper strength, and he nodded repeatedly, turned around and left.
"Princess?" Song Yong looked at Li Yunxiu.
Li Yunxiu waved his hand, "Since we didn't drink those three bowls of tea, the murderer would not have stayed in the store."
Song Yong waved his hand and all the guards sheathed their swords.
Li Yunxiu followed the waiter into the kitchen, followed by Wang Yu and Zi Ling.
The kitchen is just an ordinary kitchen. The master chef is still cooking on the stove. Another assistant cook has just delivered the chopped meat to the stove, poured himself a bowl of herbal tea, and is drinking it leisurely.
His face also turned blue-black.
"You...you..." The waiter pointed at the chef and was almost speechless.
"What's wrong with me?" the chef asked aloud, "Why did you bring the guests in..."
Before he finished speaking, the assistant cook's eyes darkened, he turned over and fell down.
Li Yunxiu came to the iron pot containing herbal tea with a cold face, sniffed it gently, sighed, and breathed a sigh of relief.
"Get in the car and let's go!"
…
One of the guards was assigned to drive the carriage, and everyone continued on the road with empty stomachs.
There was a guard who wanted to buy some buns from the bun shop next to the restaurant to satisfy his hunger, but Li Yunxiu threw the buns he bought to a wild dog on the roadside.
When they saw the wild dog squealing and then twitching and falling to the ground dead, everyone fell silent.
"The other party is a very calculating person." Li Yunxiu said in a deep voice, "He calculated that we would not dare to continue eating in the restaurant, and he also calculated that after we came out, we might buy buns from the nearby bun shop to satisfy our hunger."
"What if we find another restaurant?" Zi Ling asked.
"Maybe the food in that restaurant is poisonous." Li Yunxiu said lightly.
"Then we can find him?" Zi Ling asked.
"He is always one step ahead of us. How can we find him?" Li Yunxiu asked.
"Who is he and why is he so powerful?"
"I don't know who he is, but I know he's not that powerful."
"Huh?"
